rv.q: A rare chance to see some of a living Nobel laureate’s best work.
Not for all tastes, but definitely for those who like searching out theatre that is experimental yet approachable.
This production is highly recommended for anyone who enjoys Nordic-noir, with its take on a family living by the sea and their dysfunctional dynamics.

cn.t: This minimalist production of Fosse's Ibsen Award-winning play offers a valuable introduction to the Nobel laureate's distinctive Nordic voice, though critics are divided on its impact, with praise for its atmospheric family dysfunction.
